headline: Hoover's 10th-inning single walks off the Marlins
recap: The Phillies beat the Marlins 7-6 in 10 innings at Citizens Bank Park. Florida led 2-0 after the first, the teams traded three-run fifths to make it 5-5, and the Marlins went ahead 6-5 in the sixth. Miguel Cairo tripled in the bottom of the eighth and scored on a throwing error by second baseman Dan Uggla to tie it 6-6. In the bottom of the tenth, John Mayberry singled and moved to second on Cairo's sacrifice bunt, Jayson Werth was intentionally walked after a strikeout, and Paul Hoover singled to third base to bring Mayberry home with the winning run.

J.A. Happ started for the Phillies and lasted two innings, allowing four hits and two earned runs. Josh Johnson went 4.2 innings for Florida and gave up five earned runs, but the Marlins bullpen did not close it out. Kiko Calero was charged with a blown save, and Dan Meyer took the loss after facing five batters in the tenth.

The Phillies used eight pitchers. Kyle Kendrick, Clay Condrey, Brett Myers, Sergio Escalona, Jack Taschner and Scott Eyre followed Happ, and Chad Durbin pitched a scoreless tenth to pick up the win. Cairo went 2 for 4 with a home run and a triple, and Ben Francisco and Eric Bruntlett each had two hits.
